name: Butaperazine
summary: Butaperazine (Repoise, Tyrylen) is a typical antipsychotic of the phenothiazine class. It was approved in 1967, and possibly discontinued in the 1980s.

uses.text: It was approved in 1967, and possibly discontinued in the 1980s.

pharmacology.en: Like other phenothiazine antipsychotics, it blocks dopamine D2 receptors, which reduces the effect of dopamine in the brain pathways involved in psychosis. It also blocks histamine and acetylcholine receptors.
pharmacology.zh: 和其他吩噻嗪類抗精神病藥一樣，它阻斷多巴胺 D2 受體，減弱多巴胺在與精神病相關腦路徑中的作用。它也阻斷組織胺與乙醯膽鹼受體。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和其他吩噻嗪类抗精神病药一样，它阻断多巴胺 D2 受体，减弱多巴胺在与精神病相关脑路径中的作用。它也阻断组织胺与乙酰胆碱受体。

sideEffects.en: Older antipsychotics of this kind commonly cause stiffness, tremor, restlessness, sedation, low blood pressure on standing and raised prolactin. Long-term use risks tardive dyskinesia, lasting involuntary movements.
sideEffects.zh: 這類舊型抗精神病藥常造成肌肉僵硬、顫抖、坐立不安、鎮靜、起身時血壓偏低與泌乳素升高。長期使用有遲發性運動障礙的風險，即持續的不自主動作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 这类旧型抗精神病药常造成肌肉僵硬、颤抖、坐立不安、镇静、起身时血压偏低与泌乳素升高。长期使用有迟发性运动障碍的风险，即持续的不自主动作。

fact.en: It is a phenothiazine, the family that began with chlorpromazine, and it was approved in 1967. It appears to have been discontinued in the 1980s.
fact.zh: 它屬於吩噻嗪類，這個家族始於氯普麻，而它於 1967 年獲准上市。它似乎在 1980 年代停產。
fact.zhHans: 它属于吩噻嗪类，这个家族始于氯普麻，而它于 1967 年获准上市。它似乎在 1980 年代停产。
